headline: Startup Aina unveils a smart ring to control AI agents
summary: Startup Aina is launching a smart ring that lets users control AI agents with a tap, without needing a phone. The ring includes a screen, joystick and microphone, and can also take calls and help dictate notes on a Mac.

claims.statement: Aina is launching a smart ring designed to control AI agents.
